svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: work-tracker command group
svg.desc: The new CLI group sits between clap and the existing tracker core: it reads `[work_tracker]` from osf.toml, builds a real GitHub adapter, and delegates reads and writes to the unchanged ready/report modules.

g.text: CLI SURFACE · OSF BINARY, CLAP PARSING
WORK TRACKER CORE · EXISTING WORK_TRACKER MOD…
EXTERNAL · GITHUB PROJECT VIA GH CLI
